articles.title: China Bans Hidden EV Door Handles in World-First Safety Rule
articles.mainIdea: China Bans Hidden EV Door Handles in World-First Safety Rule
articles.summary: Bloomberg: China Bans Hidden EV Door Handles in World-First Safety Rule. Cars sold in China will be required to have mechanical release both on the inside and outside, according to new safety rules issued by the Ministry of Industry and Information Technology on Monday. Models that have already been approved by the regulator and are in the final stages of launching in China have until January 2029 to change their designs. The crackdown follows several high-profile incidents, including two fiery Xiaomi Corp. EV crashes in China where power failures were suspected to have prevented doors from opening, leaving people — unable to escape or be rescued – to die. Related tickers mentioned: BAMXF, BYDDF, GELHY, NIO, TSLA, XIACF, XIACY, XPEV.
